description: About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. description: Dein Team Wir sind URVI (Urban Vitality), eine junge Supplement-Gummy-Brand mit großen Ambitionen: über 1.000 Fünf-Sterne-Bewertungen, Presse in Vogue, GQ und der Süddeutschen Zeitung, ein wissenschaftlicher Beirat und Made in Germany. Wir entwickeln und vertreiben funktionale Gummies für das urbanen Leben, die so gut schmecken, wie sie wirken. Verkauft wird in Deutschland und den USA, über eigenen Online-Shop, Amazon, Versandapotheken (Shop Apotheke, DocMorris) und den stationären Einzelhandel (Budni, Edeka). Dein Mandat Das Wachstum der Marke in Deutschland und den USA (perspektivisch Europa), mit klarem Schwerpunkt online. Der stationäre Einzelhandel ist heute noch ein kleinerer, wachsender Teil. Die Rolle ist zugleich eine Founders'-Associate-Position: Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern David und Tilman, mit großem Einblick in Geschäftsinhalte und Verantwortung ab Tag eins. Deine Aufgaben Eigener Online-Shop Demand: Du erstellst Kampagnen und kaufst Media auf Social (Meta, TikTok) und Google (SEA), baust SEO aus und steuerst alles auf ROAS, MER und CAC. Ob in-house oder mit Agentur, die Kanäle laufen über Dich. Conversion: Sortiment, Pricing, Promotions und Merchandising liegen bei Dir. Du verbesserst den Kaufprozess über laufendes A/B-Testing (Shopify, Landing Pages, Checkout, Angebote). Retention: Du baust Wiederkaufsrate und LTV aus, über Newsletter- und E-Mail-Marketing, Subscriptions und Lifecycle-Flows (z.B. Klaviyo). Retail Commerce Distribution & Konditionen: Du baust Listung und Umsatz im Handel aus, vor allem über die Versandapotheken (Shop Apotheke, DocMorris) und im wachsenden stationären Handel (Drogerien, Supermärkte wie Budni, Edeka), und führst die Konditions- und Promo-Planung. Sichtbarkeit & Content: Du optimierst Content und PDPs auf den Plattformen und fährst die Retail-Media/Ads für Ranking und Abverkauf. Kanalübergreifend Steuerung & Reporting: Du steuerst die Marke über die wichtigsten Kennzahlen (Marge, CAC, LTV), allokierst Budget dorthin, wo der Return am höchsten ist, und lieferst das Reporting für Geschäftsführung und Investoren. Go-to-Market: Wir haben 12 Produkte am Markt und bringen in den kommenden Monaten weitere. Du verantwortest die Launches, von neuen Produkten bis zu neuen Märkten, über alle Kanäle. Forecast & Verfügbarkeit: Du stimmst die Forecasts mit Geschäftsführung, Lieferanten und Logistikdienstleistern ab und stellst sicher, dass Ware über alle Kanäle rechtzeitig verfügbar ist, damit uns keine Umsätze durch Out-of-Stocks verloren gehen. Was Du mitbringst Business Savvy: Du denkst in Umsatz, Marge und Unit Economics und weißt, wie Wachstum funktioniert Analytische Substanz: Du zerlegst Probleme sauber, arbeitest sicher mit Zahlen in Excel/Sheets und entscheidest datenbasiert. Umsetzung & Ownership: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und bringst Themen selbst ins Ziel. Relevante Erfahrung: Einige Jahre in E-Commerce, Growth, Commercial oder Consulting. Background: Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Mathematik oder ein vergleichbar quantitatives Profil. Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher. Werte: Curiosity, Hacker Mindset und Positive Mindset & Fun. Womit Du zusätzlich punktest Praktische Erfahrung mit Performance-Kanälen (SEO, SEA, Meta, TikTok) und/oder Shop-Systemen (Shopify). Erfahrung im Einzelhandel oder mit Handelsplattformen, ideal Versandapotheken (Shop Apotheke, DocMorris) oder Drogerie/LEH (Listung, Konditionen, Promo). Hintergrund im Supplement-, Health- oder FMCG-Umfeld. Erfahrung mit dem US-Markt oder internationalem E-Commerce ist ein Plus. Erfahrung mit Produkt- oder Markt-Launches. Berührungspunkte zur Logistik/Fulfillment (Forecast, Verfügbarkeit, 3PL). Du automatisierst wiederkehrende Analysen und Reportings mit KI-Tools. Was Dich bei uns erwartet Ownership & Impact: Umsatz- und Wachstumsverantwortung ab Tag 1, direkter Draht zu den Gründern, viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Team & Ort: Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg, 4 Tage vor Ort plus freitags optional remote, Kaffee, Wasser, Soft-Drinks und Snacks sind inklusive Mobilität: Deutschlandticket. Startdatum: ab 1. Oktober 2026 Dein Weg zu uns Unterlagen-Sichtung, Rückmeldung in wenigen Werktagen. Kennenlern-Call mit der Geschäftsführung (30 Min). Case: ein reales Szenario aus beiden Kanälen (z.B. "So performt unser Shop-Mix aus SEO/SEA/Meta/TikTok, wo drehst Du zuerst" und "So sehen unsere Zahlen bei Shop Apotheke und DocMorris aus, wie baust Du sie aus"). Der Case ist dein Haupt-Screen für die spezifischen Skills. Kennenlernen mit dem Team. Angebot. Alle anders, alle smart Als chancengleicher Arbeitgeber setzen wir uns bei hy für eine diverse, inklusive und gesunde Arbeitsumgebung ein. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen qualifizierten Kandidat:innen, unabhängig von Ethnie, Hautfarbe, Abstammung, Religion, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Staatsbürgerschaft, Familienstand, Behinderung oder Geschlechtsidentität. Liebe Frauen, haltet Euch nicht zurück! Untersuchungen zeigen, dass Frauen die Messlatte höher ansetzen als Männer und sich erst dann auf eine Stelle bewerben, wenn sie für eine bestimmte Position hoch qualifiziert sind. Wenn Du also der Meinung bist, dass Du einige aber nicht unbedingt alle der von uns geforderten Kriterien erfüllst, nehme bitte trotzdem Kontakt mit uns auf. Wir freuen uns sehr darauf, von Dir zu hören und gemeinsam zu prüfen, ob wir zueinander passen.

description: About Us Dyson is a global technology company. We solve problems others choose to ignore with pioneering technology that works better. Our E‑Commerce and Digital Product teams are central to how we connect with our owners—building scalable platforms and seamless experiences that define how customers discover, engage with, and buy Dyson technology globally. About The Role As a Product Manager within our E‑Commerce Product team, you will own complex, cross‑journey product areas that shape critical moments in the customer experience. Operating within high-impact, high-visibility problem spaces, you will lead discovery, define strategy and drive delivery that improves both customer confidence and commercial performance. You will act as the Product Manager for key decision-making journeys—most notably the “commit” stage—where customers move from consideration to purchase. You will ensure customers are equipped with the clarity, trust and information needed to confidently choose Dyson technology. You will bring structured thinking to ambiguity, balancing strategic direction with hands-on execution in partnership with design, engineering and experimentation teams. Key Responsibilities Own complex product areas spanning multiple squads, business units and customer journeys Lead problem framing and opportunity discovery, selecting the right discovery methods to validate hypotheses Define and maintain a clear product vision that guides team priorities and decision-making Influence prioritisation and roadmap decisions across regions and business units Drive net new product and feature development—from concept to validation through experimentation, to scaled delivery Maintain a forward-looking roadmap (3+ quarters) that shapes wider team and stakeholder plans Use behavioural data, customer insight and experimentation to optimise conversion and customer confidence Lead product development across core decision-making experiences such as Product Detail Pages, comparison tools and “help me choose” features Partner cross-functionally to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions with measurable impact Model strong product management practices, supporting and influencing more junior team members Success in this role is defined by sustained improvements in conversion, clarity of decision-making and customer confidence—not output alone. About you Experienced Product Manager, comfortable owning complex, cross-functional product areas within e-commerce or digital product environments Proven ability to lead discovery, structure ambiguous problems and translate insight into clear action Strong commercial awareness, with a focus on driving measurable business outcomes Experience working with experimentation, customer data and insight to inform product decisions Confident influencing stakeholders across teams, markets and levels of seniority Able to define and communicate clear product vision and direction Comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-impact environments, including new product launches Strong collaborator, working effectively with engineering, design and broader business teams Leads through action—raising standards and modelling strong product thinking for others Curious, structured and outcome-driven. You bring clarity where others see complexity. Reward At Dyson, Reward goes beyond just salary and bonuses. Through a comprehensive package of Financial, Lifestyle, and Health Benefits, we provide support tailored to every stage of life and the moments that matter most. Working policy Our campus culture is built on connection—collaboration in person, shared creativity, and hands-on learning. That’s why we don’t offer a hybrid arrangement. Working side by side powers our best ideas, fuels belonging, and keeps us pushing boundaries together. Please note At Dyson in the Netherlands, all new joiners start on a one-year, fixed-term contract. Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

description: Shape the future of innovative conveyor solutions with AmbaFlex! Are you passionate about turning customer and market needs into products that can be confidently specified, sold, produced, installed and serviced worldwide? Do you enjoy leading cross-functional initiatives at the intersection of technology, commercialization and lifecycle performance? At AmbaFlex, we're looking for a Product Manager who can connect market opportunities with the organization and turn product ideas into globally launch-ready solutions. Who are we? At AmbaFlex, we are the global leader in spiral conveyor solutions. Our systems keep production and logistics processes moving for some of the world's leading companies in food & beverage, e-commerce fulfilment, parcel logistics and manufacturing. Innovation is at the heart of everything we do. That's why we continuously invest in new products, smarter solutions and technologies that create value for our customers worldwide. Product Manager - Product Introduction & Lifecycle As Product Manager, you act as the Industry Product Lead for an assigned portfolio. You connect Industry Business Development, Technology/Engineering and the functions that must sell, produce, install and service the product. Business Development drives market development and key accounts, while Technology owns technical design and validation. You own the integrated introduction and lifecycle-readiness process that brings all contributions together. You work across Idea-to-Market, Market-to-Order and the feedback loop from Order-to-Cash. From portfolio mapping and gap analysis to business-case preparation, stage-gate coordination, global launch, regional onboarding and post-launch follow-up, you ensure products become commercially usable, operationally repeatable and fully supported solutions. What you'll do Maintain a structured product and portfolio map, including lifecycle status, variants, gaps and improvement priorities. Translate insights from consultants and architects, system integrators, end users and regional teams into clear requirements together with Business Development, the Industry Application Engineer and Technology. Prepare decision-ready gap analyses, value propositions and business cases for new products, product improvements and lifecycle decisions. Act as the internal project manager for product introductions and major lifecycle changes, using an integrated plan, stage-gates, owners, milestones, dependencies, risks and clear definitions of done. Coordinate readiness across Technology/Engineering, Product Engineering, Operations, Quality, Marketing, Sales and Service, while specialist functions retain ownership of their technical content and sign-offs. Coordinate the market-introduction package and regional onboarding: training, battlecards, whitepapers, webpage content, presentations, consultant specification material, system-integrator guidance, demonstrations and exhibition preparation. Ensure visibility and completion of product, operational and service deliverables such as PDCs and configuration guidance, product data and BOM status, production/test checklists, manuals, compliance readiness, spare-parts packages, maintenance concepts and pricing alignment. Support first-of-kind and pilot introductions, capture lessons learned and turn them into product, documentation, training, service and process improvements. Run post-launch reviews, monitor adoption and performance, maintain the lifecycle-improvement backlog and drive agreed actions to closure. What success looks like Products launch with a complete sales, service, operations, documentation and technical-readiness package. Regional teams are trained and equipped before launch, with one consistent product story and clear application/configuration guidance. Late blockers and ad-hoc firefighting are reduced, while customer and field feedback is converted into measurable lifecycle improvements. Who should apply? We're looking for a technically minded, commercially aware and highly structured professional who enjoys bringing people, technology and market ambitions together. You lead through influence, create clarity across functions and follow through until the complete result is delivered. You bring: A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering, Product Management or a comparable technical-commercial discipline. Several years of experience in product management, new-product introduction, commercialization or technical project/program management within a technical B2B environment. A proven ability to translate customer and market needs into clear requirements, business cases, priorities and executable plans. Experience leading cross-functional product introductions in an international matrix organization, preferably without direct authority over all contributors. Working knowledge of stage-gate/product-development processes and sufficient technical understanding of configuration, BOM/product data, testing, documentation, compliance readiness, serviceability and spare-parts concepts. Strong project-management, analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical, operational and commercial teams. Fluency in English and willingness to travel internationally when needed. Experience within intralogistics, automation, industrial equipment or capital goods - particularly in a market involving consultants, system integrators and end customers - is considered a strong advantage. What we offer A visible role with the opportunity to professionalize and shape our end-to-end product-introduction and lifecycle process. The opportunity to influence products from early market need through global launch and continuous improvement. Close collaboration with highly skilled commercial, application, engineering, operations, marketing and service teams. An international scope, working with colleagues and regional organizations around the world. Plenty of room for personal growth and professional development. An entrepreneurial environment where initiative, ownership and innovation are encouraged. Competitive employment conditions and flexible working arrangements. Join us today! Ready to turn market opportunities into complete, globally supported product introductions and help shape the future of our product portfolio? Apply today and become part of the AmbaFlex team.

You’ll Join a Company Where People help each other out; Ideas and people matter more than job titles; Hard work matters, and so does enjoying the ride; If something can be better, we improve it. What you get You step into a role with real influence on digital product development. You’ll work in a close-knit specialist team with room to grow, build and accelerate. description: BASIC SUMMARY: ( US healthcare experience is a must) We are seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused Product Owner to support the delivery of features and enhancements within our healthcare claims administration platform. This role is responsible for translating business and stakeholder needs into clear, actionable user stories and working closely with engineering teams to ensure timely, high-quality delivery. The ideal candidate brings healthcare domain knowledge, understands Agile processes, and is comfortable using AI-enabled tools to support requirements definition and backlog management. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Backlog Ownership & Agile Execution Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring stories are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with sprint goals Write epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and customer-centric Conduct regular backlog grooming and sprint planning in collaboration with the Scrum team Participate in daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as an active team member Ensure user stories meet the definition of ready and done before development and release Requirements Gathering & User Story Development Collaborate with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and internal teams to gather and refine product requirements Use AI tools (where applicable) to support the creation of epics, themes, and user stories Conduct gap analysis and validation of requirements to ensure completeness and feasibility Support refinement of use cases, workflows, and functional documentation Cross-Functional Collaboration Serve as the primary point of contact for development teams during sprint execution Partner with UX/UI designers to ensure user stories are aligned with design principles and usability goals Support QA teams by clarifying acceptance criteria and reviewing test cases as needed Coordinate with other Product Owners to manage interdependencies between features Customer & Stakeholder Engagement Participate in stakeholder meetings to capture feature requests, enhancement ideas, and feedback Communicate updates to internal stakeholders on backlog priorities, delivery timelines, and sprint progress Help ensure features delivered meet customer needs and stakeholder expectations. Familiarity with Agile software development and Scrum methodology Proficiency with Jira (or similar Agile tools) for backlog management Experience using AI-assisted tools to help structure requirements and analyze user input (preferred but not required) Basic understanding of software development processes and technical constraints Familiarity with collaboration tools (e.g., Confluence, Miro, Figma) Strong written and verbal communication skills for conveying requirements and feedback High attention to detail and organizational skills Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment Comfortable working with cross-functional teams and resolving blockers quickly Preferred Qualifications Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification Understanding of healthcare data standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, X12 EDI)

Experience collaborating with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers to deliver customer-centric solutions. Comfort working in fast-paced environments where priorities shift, and the ability to adapt quickly while maintaining focus on delivering value. Analytical mindset with the ability to use qualitative and quantitative data to drive decision-making. A proactive, detail-oriented approach and an ownership mentality. A passion for improving user experience and driving business impact through execution excellence. Important note: please do apply if you meet 70%+ of the criteria. description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code. We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe. Accounts (DDAs, FBOs, virtual accounts) are the product; the API and dashboard are how customers experience it. Your domain runs across accounts, API, dashboard, IAM, and the end-to-end customer experience. The end state: an enterprise customer sets up an Augustus account and is moving money the same day - accounts that are effortless to create, an API that's a joy to integrate, and a dashboard with the speed and precision of the best modern software, not what anyone expects from a bank. Your job is to challenge the status quo - to take everything customers hate about bank interfaces and account setup, and build the version they've never been able to get from a bank before. You'll get deep into the use cases our customers are building: how a stablecoin operator structures virtual accounts, how a fintech's engineers experience our API on day one, how an operator lives in our dashboard every day. That understanding lets you work with design and engineering to develop our platform to uniquely solve for our customers' needs. You report to Will, Head of Product, and work closely with Simon, our CTO. You're expected to operate with full autonomy on your team's roadmap. You establish yourself with customers, getting deep on how they set up and use accounts and where we're falling short. You define and ship your first project. Months 3-4: Full execution mode. You're unblocking engineering daily, making hard prioritization calls, and keeping the roadmap moving. You're raising the bar across accounts, API, and dashboard, and feeding what you learn from customers straight back into the product. Months 5-6: You're working with live customers on the products you've built, and deposits and account holders are scaling. You've moved from execution to platform mode - evolving the roadmap based on what your first customers are actually building on top of Augustus, and pushing the account and dashboard experience further than any of them expected a bank could go. Set The Bar: You're harder on yourself than anyone else would be. You don't need external accountability to care about quality. Shape The Game: You don't wait for a playbook and you don't need one. You walk into genuinely new territory and figure it out. You move before anyone asked you to. Systems First: You don't solve problems by adding people or effort. You build systems that make the problem smaller. Your first instinct is to automate, not to handle it manually. This role is for you if: You want to spend time with customers and translate what you hear into actionable insights for your team and our entire product strategy. Your ambition is to become the top 1% expert in banking experience - accounts, developer experience, and the interfaces on top of them. You go deeper than anyone asks, you know exactly where the points of leverage are. You have taste. You know the difference between a dashboard that works and one that people love, and you can't ship the former. You combine first-principles thinking with deep domain knowledge to build things that don't exist yet. You find the intersection of technically possible and uniquely valuable - and bring it into reality. You are excited about what the Programmable Bank can become and you're ready to be a meaningful part of building it. The magnitude of the opportunity doesn't intimidate you, it excites you. You're confident delivering on company-critical projects alongside an engineering team. You push the boundaries of what a PM can do by leveraging AI. This is not for you if: You're not working directly with customers as part of your day to day. You think great products and fast shipping can't coexist in a regulatory environment.
